note: Normative cross-language vectors. Each case calls `fn` with `args`; `expect` is {result} or {error: code}. `run` scripts set the clock with `at`.

cases.name: run ttl expiry boundary is exclusive
run defaultTtl applies when ttl absent
run touch extends and clears expiry
run touch without ttl uses defaultTtl
run expired entry is not touched
run lru evicts least recently used
run lru has and peek do not refresh
run lru overwrite does not evict
run lru prefers purging expired over evicting
run lru touch and increment refresh
run lru add on full cache
run add only when absent or expired
run remember invalid value counts no miss
run increment keeps expiry and tags
run increment new key uses ttl
run invalidate tag counts expired separately
